outcome: Adverse neonatal outcomes (low birthweight, very low birthweight, preterm birth, very preterm birth, small-for-gestational age, large-for-gestational age, early neonatal death)
cohort: 3556 live-born infants after in vitro fertilization and vitrified embryo transfer cycles
finding: Compared with the GnRH-agonist short protocol, the DYG + hMG protocol did not compromise neonatal outcomes or increase congenital malformation risks.
mod_finding: The two protocols showed no significant differences in mode of delivery.
